I checked your account and recent activity to start.

What I did
- Looked up your account (ACC-1011) and recent transactions.

What I found
- Your GBP account balance is £61,200.00.
- Recent outgoing payments of similar or larger size (one for £4,200 settled on 2026-09-15; one for £26,000 settled on 2026-09-02), so you have sufficient funds to cover a €4,500 payment.

What happens next / what I need from you
- I can’t confirm “will go through today” without two details: (1) Is the payment coming from your GBP account (ACC-1011)? and (2) what rail/transfer type is it (SEPA to an EU IBAN, or an international/SWIFT transfer)?
- If it’s a SEPA payment to an EU IBAN and you send before our SEPA cut-off, it’s usually same‑day; if it’s SWIFT or another rail it may take longer. I don’t have the cut-off/timeframe in the tools yet, so I can run an FX quote and check eligibility/cutoff as soon as you confirm the transfer type and that you want me to proceed.

Tell me the transfer type (SEPA or international) and confirm it’s from ACC-1011 and I’ll run the quote and give a firm answer.
